title: Peanut Noodles
description: Ginger comes alive when its warmed, and it gets that opportunity in this tasty sauce. All the ingredients - peanut butter to sesame oil -are warmed together in a pan until their flavors blend and the sauce becomes flavorful.
ingredients: 1 bunch green onions, sliced (white parts only)

steps.text: Cook pasta in a large pot of boiling water until done. Drain.

Meanwhile, combine oil and onions in a small skillet. Saute over low heat until tender. Add ginger; cook and stir for 1 to 2 minutes. Mix in peanut butter, soy sauce, water, vinegar, sugar, and red pepper flakes. Remove from heat.
Toss noodles with sauce, and serve.

video.description: In this video, you’ll see how to make noodles with a simple, savory peanut sauce. Peanut butter combines with minced fresh ginger, soy sauce, a little cider vinegar, and red pepper flakes to create a deeply flavorful sauce to toss with hot noodles. Use your favorite pasta. Spaghetti works great. Or try soba noodles, a traditional buckwheat-flour noodle. If you like, jazz things up with fresh vegetables, like snap peas, carrots, and red bell peppers, for a filling, healthy dinner that’s ready in no time.
